description: Performances and competitions from DEF CON Safe Mode's inaugural New Year's Eve Party, featuring the Hacker Jeopardy championship tiebreaker and virtual DJ sets.

talks.title: Hacker Jeopardy Tiebreaker: Church of WiFi vs Show&TELNET
talks.teaser: The legendary tiebreaker match of Hacker Jeopardy at the DEF CON 2020 New Year's Eve Party between Church of WiFi and Show&TELNET.
talks.summary:
In this special New Year's Eve 2020 virtual event from DEF CON, iconic hacker crews Church of WiFi and Show&TELNET face off in a historic Hacker Jeopardy tiebreaker showdown. Opening at 00:00, the emcees welcome virtual partygoers to the extended holiday contest, establishing the boisterous rules and drinking penalties for the sudden-death competition.

Across the hour-plus broadcast, teams battle through obscure telecommunications lore, vintage phone phreaking history, wireless protocol trivia, and convention memories.

The clash between two legendary hacker collectives showcases sharp technical humor and camaraderie, delivering an unforgettable holiday tradition for the DEF CON community. (AI summary — Gemini Flash)

talks.title: New Year's Eve Live Set: Skittish & Bus
talks.teaser: Skittish and Bus perform a live DJ and music video set to ring in 2021 during the inaugural DEF CON New Year's Eve virtual celebration.
talks.summary:
Electronic musical duo Skittish & Bus deliver an energetic live musical performance for DEF CON's inaugural New Year's Eve virtual celebration, broadcast to ring in 2021 [00:00]. The performance features a dynamic blend of electronic dance music, hip-hop, glitch-hop, and club beats accompanied by live vocals, synth sequencing, and energetic crowd interaction across the virtual chat stream [07:03].

The duo cycles through an eclectic setlist of original tracks and remixed electronic anthems, featuring pulsating basslines, vocoded refrains, and rhythmic vocal performances [13:43, 21:14]. Throughout the performance, Skittish & Bus engage with the global online hacker community, celebrating fellowship, resilience, and the creative intersection between underground electronic music and hacker culture [26:31, 36:38].

talks.summary:
Social Engineering and Human-Oriented Security

This presentation explores social engineering attacks and human vulnerability in security systems. Topics include psychological manipulation, pretexting, credential harvesting, and how attackers exploit human nature to bypass technical defenses.

talks.title: Save the Date - DEF CON's first New Year's Eve party!
talks.teaser: Save-the-date promo for DEF CON’s first New Year’s Eve party.
talks.summary:
This official promotional teaser announces DEF CON's inaugural global New Year's Eve virtual celebration, held from December 31, 2020 through January 1, 2021 [00:01]. Hosted on the official DEF CON Discord server, the event invites the worldwide hacker community to celebrate the end of a tumultuous year together in a relaxed, social online environment [00:10].

The announcement highlights the party's lineup of community entertainment, including Hacker Jeopardy, Drunk Hacker History, live musical and DJ sets, movie screenings, and celebrity bartender appearances [00:18]. Emphasizing community connection and informal fellowship without the formalities of standard conference tracks, the teaser encourages hackers everywhere to tune in and ring in the new year together [00:25].
